decisive_items: Progression from discrete right papillary edema to severe optic nerve atrophy
Fluorescein leakage from retinal venules inferotemporal to the macula
Positive nasopharyngeal swab RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2
response.rationale: Post-infectious optic neuritis best fits the temporal sequence of SARS-CoV-2 infection followed by optic nerve inflammation and atrophy, with retinal vasculitis as a secondary feature. Viral optic neuritis is plausible but less specific for the post-infectious immune-mediated course.

rejected.why: SARS-CoV-2 infection is the underlying trigger, not the most likely diagnosis for the ocular syndrome.
Viral optic neuritis implies direct viral invasion, but CSF PCR was negative and the course suggests post-infectious inflammation.
Retinal vasculitis is a component of the presentation, not the overarching diagnosis.
